description:
Change one of the user's own saved browser tasks: rename it, change its steps, move its start page within the same site, or unpublish it (status "draft") and publish it again (status "published"). Call it when the user asks to edit, rename, unpublish or republish a saved task ("modifie ma tâche relevé Banque A : prends aussi le PDF", "unpublish Supplier A invoices"), with the browser_skill_id that well_list_browser_skills gave. When no list was read in this conversation, call well_list_browser_skills first; when several saved tasks could match, ask which one as a numbered list.

Pass only what changes. A new name, new steps or a new start page make a new version, and the earlier version stays in the history. Unpublishing keeps the task and its versions; the person can no longer rerun it in one word until it is published again.

A saved task always stays on its site: a start page on another site, or another subdomain, is refused, and nothing changes. To run a task on another site, the person saves a new task from a run there. Its inputs come from the run it was saved from and cannot change here. Deleting is well_delete_browser_skill.

The result has the saved task's name, its version and its status: say what changed in one line, with the version, and never show the id. A refusal means nothing changed: say so in one line, and do not retry.

browser_skill_id.description: The saved task to change, as well_list_browser_skills returned its id.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A retried write with the same key returns the original result instead of re-applying the operation.

instructions.description: The new steps of the saved task, in full, as the person asked. Omit them to keep the steps.

name.description: The new name, on one line. Omit it to keep the name.

start_url.description: The new start page, an https page of the same site. Omit it to keep the start page.

status.description: "draft" unpublishes the saved task, "published" publishes it again. Omit it to keep the status.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several — a write lands in exactly one workspace and this call would not say which.

workspace_scope.description: Restrict this call to the family: the token's primary workspace plus the company workspaces under it that you are a member of. Unrelated authorized workspaces drop out of the read; row reads merge across the family, while a per-workspace figure still reports exactly one workspace.

name: well_update_browser_skill

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

name.description: The saved task's name after the change.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. The connected-line rule says when to tell an entry; when it does, one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

status.description: published or draft, after the change.

version.description: The saved task's version after the change.

title: Change a saved browser task
